As Accenture Plc Ireland (ACN) Market Valuation Declined, Woodley Farra Manion Portfolio Management Trimmed Stake; As Anthem (ANTM) Stock Declined, Putnam Investments Upped Stake by $41.88 Million
May 18, 2018 - By Vivian Currie
Putnam Investments Llc increased its stake in Anthem Inc (ANTM) by 192.84% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Putnam Investments Llc bought 186,126 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 282,645 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $63.60 million, up from 96,519 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Putnam Investments Llc who had been investing in Anthem Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $59.19 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.06% or $0.15 $231.94. About 262,567 shares traded. Anthem, Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) has risen 35.30% uptrending. It has outperformed by 23.75% the S&P500.
Woodley Farra Manion Portfolio Management Inc decreased its stake in Accenture Plc Ireland (ACN) by 1.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Woodley Farra Manion Portfolio Management Inc sold 2,969 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.27% with the market. The institutional investor held 248,820 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $38.09 million, down from 251,789 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Woodley Farra Manion Portfolio Management Inc who had been investing in Accenture Plc Ireland for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $100.14 billion market cap company.
